message: The other day, I set off our smoke alarm while making a simple stir-fry, and it got me thinking about how we sometimes forget the basics. We ended up turning it into a family game—seeing who could come up with the best escape plan while fanning the smoke away. It reminded me that even in the midst of a little chaos, there’s fun to be had in rediscovering low-tech solutions. So, have you practiced your escape plan lately?
